claim: V_OH, V_OL, duty cycle and 10-90% edge time at the buffered CLK pin (design/clk-buf, issue #232) across the full 45-point PVT grid (DR-003 five-corner set x -40/27/125 C x 1.62/1.80/1.98 V), into the provisional 1 pF CLK-to-GND characterization load of spec/decision-records/DR-008-clk-output-load-and-buffer-scope.md. Measured design input toward the DRAFT spec rows 14 and 15; it ratifies nothing, excludes pad/package/ESD capability, and a miss against the DRAFT bounds is recorded as a miss. The ring is held open-loop at a fixed VCTRL of 0.865 V (the near-250 MHz point of sim/vco-clk-transition), so the grid exercises the buffer across process, temperature and supply at one drive frequency per corner; the loaded closed-loop view is sim/pll-lock, sim/pll-lock-1mhz and sim/pll-lock-25mhz.
spec_rows_note: spec/target-spec.md row 14 (output duty cycle, 45-55 %) and row 15 (output levels V_OH >= 0.9*VDD / V_OL <= 0.1*VDD into a stated load), both DRAFT. The 'stated load' is DR-008's provisional 1 pF lumped characterization load, not a ratified interface; the record reports each figure next to the DRAFT bound and does not gate on it.
methodology_note: this testbench's DUT is design/vco/vco_ring5.sch (open loop, VCTRL fixed at 0.865 V) followed by design/clk-buf/clk_buf.sch driving a 1 pF CLK-to-GND capacitor (DR-008); the measured node is the buffered pin. Frequency, duty, 10-90% rise/fall (`measure.transition`) and settled V_OH/V_OL (`measure.levels`, issue #232: medians of the samples above/below mid-supply, with the true extremes printed beside them) are all taken over the post-60 ns population. Levels, duty and edge time are reported and never gate the verdict; the verdict gates only on the buffer chain oscillating at every point. The 1 pF load is lumped: it excludes bond-wire/pad/package inductance and ESD structures, so no figure here is pad capability. `tran_step` 10 ps resolves the ~100-200 ps loaded edges (>= 5 samples per edge, the condition sim/harness/measure.py states). The reducer's V_OH/V_OL figure is a median, not an extreme, so a ringing overshoot is shown only in the 'extremes' clause.
analysis: transient per PVT point (`tran 10p 200n uic`, one ngspice invocation per point)
